folioId.description: Reviewed folio id, presented as the final invoice; it must be the folio Billing returns for the stay.

folioBalanceMinor.description: Deprecated advisory input: ignored. Stay re-reads the folio balance through Billing GetFolioBalance (ADR-0005 D2/D5).

openBalanceApproval.description: Deprecated advisory input: ignored. Stay re-reads the recorded approval from Billing and requires the approver identity, a role from the fixed three, and a recorded time.

actualDeparture.description: Late departure kept on the stay; now() when absent.

errors.when: Missing session token, including a session Billing rejects on the gate read.
Open balance without a provenanced recorded approval; details carry folioId and reason (no_approval or approval_incomplete). The stay remains in house.
The presented folioId is not the stay's folio; details name folioId and actualFolioId. The stay remains in house.
The folio could not be read from Billing; details name upstream and operation. The stay remains in house.
Stay is not in house; details name the stay and its state.
Missing or malformed stay, folio, or actor.
